consumer: The pickup path calling Character::can_pick_weight(item) to gate the pickup, asking the yes/no 'can the avatar take on this item's weight given what they already carry?'
scope: only the character's own carried weight vs own capacity (weight_carried + this one candidate item's weight), not nearby/reachable inventory
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::can_pick_weight — returns a bool by comparing weight_carried()+weight against weight_capacity() (or weight_capacity()*4 / mass_max in the unsafe / DEBUG_STORAGE branches), not weight_capacity() alone
divergence: Avatar already carrying near-capacity (weight_carried()+it.weight() > weight_capacity() but it.weight() alone <= weight_capacity()): the real predicate returns false, while a re-derivation from weight_capacity() that ignores already-carried load returns true; the unsafe *4 branch likewise flips the boundary
